newsitem.title: UK: Invesco secures loan to complete AIM merger.
newsitem.headline: Invesco secures loan to complete AIM merger.

text.p: Investment management company Invesco Plc said on Friday it has received loan commitments from a syndicate of banks allowing it to complete its proposed merger with AIM Management Group Inc.

Invesco also said that conversion of the 54,269,108 units of convertible unsecured loan stock in Invesco Funding LLC into ordinary shares of Invesco Plc due to take place on February 14, has been postponed and will now take place by March 12, 1997.
The postponement will enable more of the conditions attached to the merger to be satisfied prior to conversion taking place, said the company in a statement.
The merger is expected to be completed on February 28.
On Thursday Britain's Secretary of State for Trade and Industry approved the merger.
Invesco announced the combination with the U.S. mutual fund company last November, creating a combined group called AMVESCO with around $150 billion under management.
